mechanical_audit: Parse all records for hashed linkage, label availability and declared field/schema counts only. Do not display later bodies or labels by case, train a model or compute classifier metrics.
profile_edges: Exact hash of stable browser fields ua/platform/deviceType/screen/colorDepth/canvas/cores/memory, with at least three meaningful values. This is profile equivalence, not verified physical-device identity.
request_template_edges: Exact method, normalized URL and request JSON after only explicit volatile ID/time normalization; not arbitrary shared HTTP paths or JSON schema alone. This is a conservative diagnostic for repeated generation patterns.
probe_taint: All records in a component containing any of the first128 observed development records are development-tainted. Do not relabel them as final.
unlinked_rows: Report missing linkage separately; do not call singleton rows independent trials by default.
labels: Explicit top-level boolean Suspicious/suspicious only; absent/nonboolean/conflicting aliases are unknown. Never default non-JSON telemetry to normal.
field_presence: Field/type presence is an unverified historical observation, not current authenticated authority or usable role/posture/approval policy.
